content.title: Cameron Young’s Caddie Kyle Sterbinsky Is One of His Best Friends
content.text: Meet Cameron Young’s Caddie Kyle SterbinskyJared C. Tilton - Getty Images (Jared C. Tilton - Getty Images)As Cameron Young looks to win his first major at the Masters today, on his bag is his caddie and friend, Kyle Sterbinsky. The two men have a long history; they were college teammates at Wake Forest University, competing together on the men’s golf team at the North Carolina school.“Caddies can help you with a lot of things, but I don’t know how many you’re going to find who are actually better at reading greens than any of the players,” Young said of Sterbinsky. “If he’s not better, he’s very, very good.”Here, what to know about Cameron Young’s caddie Kyle Sterbinsky.Young and Sterbinsky at the Masters.Andrew Redington - Getty Images (Andrew Redington - Getty Images)He’s from Pennsylvania.Sterbinsky grew up in Yardley, PA, and attend the Peddie School. As a high school freshman, he qualified for sectionals of the U.S. Open, won the Garden State Cup, and he was ranked No. 9 in his class by Golfweek.Sterbinsky played collegiate golf.As a freshman at Wake Forest, he qualified for the 2016 U.S. Amateur Championship.Sterbinsky plays his tee shot on the 1st hole during Day Two of the final stage of the DP World Tour’s Qualifying School in November 2023.Octavio Passos - Getty Images (Octavio Passos - Getty Images)He made the switch from pro golfer to caddie.The duo at the 2025 Ryder Cup.Scott Taetsch/PGA of America - Getty Images (Scott Taetsch/PGA of America - Getty Images)“He was nearing the end of when he was going to keep playing or not. I needed a change. Things were going poorly, and when things are going bad, you change something,” Young said of asking Sterbinsky to caddie for him last summer.“I didn’t want to force his hand,” Young continued. “He said, ‘Yes, I’ll work for you as long as you want.’ It was going to be a couple of weeks. Played well. Another four weeks. Played well. And here we are.”Young and Sterbinsky after Young won The Players Championship in 2026.Ben Jared - Getty Images (Ben Jared - Getty Images)Sterbinsky began working as Young’s caddie at the 2025 Truist Championship, and they have worked together since.After he won the Wyndham Championship, Young said, “Kyle’s one of my best friends, a college teammate, and he’s great at reading greens. He’s very quickly picking up a lot of the technical skills that are required to be a really good caddie out here. He’s been a great resource for me.”You Might Also Like
